title: AI Agent Bridge
summary: Ask your running game a question in chat and read the AI answer in chat, with item icons and map pings. Works on any multiplayer server for every force, other mods add lookups. The mod is the game side of an open protocol over RCON; run the agent from GitHub with your own model key, or write your own.
tags_intentionally_empty: No tag in the live portal vocabulary is honestly true of an AI question bridge; it is a gameplay-domain vocabulary. Discovery rests on title and summary.
